bambu.bed_heat_soak_area.label: Bed heat soak area
bambu.bed_heat_soak_area.provenance: Ported from BambuStudio@79df7ae:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp:1086 (label generated from the key)

bambu.z_direction_outwall_speed_continuo.label: Smoothing wall speed along Z(experimental)
bambu.z_direction_outwall_speed_continuo.tooltip: Smoothing outwall speed in z direction to get better surface quality. Print time will increases. This does not work on spiral vase mode.

bambu.avoid_crossing_wall_includes_suppo.label: Avoid crossing wall - Includes support
bambu.avoid_crossing_wall_includes_suppo.tooltip: Including support while avoiding crossing wall.

bambu.pre_start_fan_time.label: Pre start fan time
bambu.pre_start_fan_time.tooltip: Force fan start early(0-5 second) when encountering overhangs. This is because the fan needs time to physically increase its speed.

bambu.overhang_threshold_participating_c.label: Overhang threshold for participating cooling
bambu.overhang_threshold_participating_c.tooltip: Decide which overhang part join the cooling function to slow down the speed.Expressed as percentage which indicides how much width of the line without support from lower layer. 100% means forcing cooling for all outer wall no matter how much overhang degree

bambu.top_one_wall_type.label: Only one wall on top surfaces
bambu.top_one_wall_type.tooltip: Use only one wall on flat top surface, to give more space to the top infill pattern. Could be applied on topmost surface or all top surface.

bambu.top_area_threshold.label: Top area threshold
bambu.top_area_threshold.tooltip: The min width of top areas in percentage of perimeter line width.

bambu.overhang_totally_speed.tooltip: Speed of 100% overhang wall which has 0 overlap with the lower layer.

bambu.enable_height_slowdown.label: Slow down by height
bambu.enable_height_slowdown.tooltip: Enable this option to slow printing down by height

bambu.slowdown_start_height.label: Starting height
bambu.slowdown_start_height.tooltip: The height starts to slow down

bambu.slowdown_end_height.label: Ending height
bambu.slowdown_end_height.tooltip: The height finishes slowing down, Ending height should be larger than Starting height, or the slowing down will not work!

bambu.no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwal.label: Don't slow down outer walls
bambu.no_slow_down_for_cooling_on_outwal.tooltip:
If enabled, this setting will ensure external perimeters are not slowed down to meet the minimum layer time. This is particularly helpful in the below scenarios:
1. To avoid changes in shine when printing glossy filaments
2. To avoid changes in external wall speed which may create slight wall artifacts that appear like Z banding
3. To avoid printing at speeds which cause VFAs (fine artifacts) on the external walls

bambu.cooling_slowdown_logic.label: Cooling slowdown logic
bambu.cooling_slowdown_logic.tooltip:
Determines how the printer slows down when minimum layer time isn't reached.

'Uniform cooling' slows down all print features equally (current default behavior).

'Consistent surface' prioritizes slowing infill and internal perimeters first, preserving external perimeter speed for better surface finish on glossy filaments. This helps reduce VFA (Vertical Fine Artifacts) and maintains consistent surface shine.

bambu.cooling_perimeter_transition_dista.label: Perimeter transition distance
bambu.cooling_perimeter_transition_dista.tooltip:
Distance in millimeters before the end of slowed perimeters where the original print speed is gradually restored. This reduces quality issues when transitioning from slowed features to fast external perimeter printing.

Only applies when 'Consistent surface' cooling logic is selected.
Recommended value: 5-10mm. Set to 0 to disable.

bambu.travel_short_distance_acceleration.label: Short travel
bambu.travel_short_distance_acceleration.tooltip:
Acceleration used for short travel moves near external perimeters. Short travels are moves shorter than the 'Retraction minimum travel' distance.

Lower values (e.g., 250-500 mm/s²) reduce ringing artifacts on sharp corners without significantly impacting print time.

Set to 0 to disable (uses normal travel acceleration).

bambu.first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.label: Fan speed
bambu.first_x_layer_part_fan_speed.tooltip: Part cooling fan speed for the first few layers. Set to 0 to disable the part cooling fan on the initial layers for better bed adhesion

bambu.vertical_shell_speed.label: Vertical shell speed
bambu.vertical_shell_speed.tooltip: Speed for vertical shells with overhang regions. If expressed as percentage (for example: 80%) it will be calculated onthe internal solid infill speed above

bambu.detect_floating_vertical_shell.label: Detect floating vertical shells
bambu.detect_floating_vertical_shell.tooltip: Detect overhang paths in vertical shells and slow them by bridge speed.

bambu.internal_bridge_support_thickness.label: Internal bridge support thickness
bambu.internal_bridge_support_thickness.tooltip: When sparse infill density is low, the internal solid infill or internal bridge may have no archor at the end of line. This causes falling and bad quality when printing internal solid infill. When enable this feature, loop paths will be added to the sparse fill of the lower layers for specific thickness, so that better archor can be provided for internal bridge. 0 means disable this feature

bambu.monotonic_travel_into_wall.label: Monotonic line travel extend
bambu.monotonic_travel_into_wall.tooltip: Enable this option to extend the travel distance between lines, improving the adhesion between the monotonic line infill and the walls.(percent to line width)

bambu.sub_top_surface_pattern.label: Sub-top surface pattern
bambu.sub_top_surface_pattern.tooltip: Line pattern of the solid layer that supports a visible top surface. Its lines can print through and mark the top, so a monotonic pattern gives the smoothest result. The whole solid area that a top surface reaches uses this pattern, not only the part directly beneath it.

bambu.process_notes.label: Process notes
bambu.process_notes.tooltip: You can put your notes regarding the process here.

bambu.ams_filament_load_time_ams.label: AMS filament load time
bambu.ams_filament_load_time_ams.tooltip: Filament load time when printing with an AMS. For statistics only

bambu.ams_filament_load_time_ams_lite.label: AMS Lite filament load time
bambu.ams_filament_load_time_ams_lite.tooltip: Filament load time when printing with an AMS Lite. For statistics only

bambu.ams_filament_load_time_n3f_s.label: N3F/N3S filament load time
bambu.ams_filament_load_time_n3f_s.tooltip: Filament load time when printing with an N3F or N3S. For statistics only

bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_ams.label: AMS filament unload time
bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_ams.tooltip: Filament unload time when printing with an AMS. For statistics only

bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_ams_lite.label: AMS Lite filament unload time
bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_ams_lite.tooltip: Filament unload time when printing with an AMS Lite. For statistics only

bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_n3f_s.label: N3F/N3S filament unload time
bambu.ams_filament_unload_time_n3f_s.tooltip: Filament unload time when printing with an N3F or N3S. For statistics only

bambu.default_ams_type.label: Default AMS type
bambu.default_ams_type.tooltip: The default AMS type used to estimate filament load/unload time, stored as the AMS timing type enum value. It comes from the printer preset and does not reflect the AMS currently attached to the machine.

bambu.filament_velocity_adaptation_facto.label: Velocity Adaptation Factor
bambu.filament_velocity_adaptation_facto.tooltip: This parameter reflects the speed at which a material transitions from one state to another. It, along with the smooth coefficient, determines the final length of the transition zone. A larger value: requires a shorter transition zone. A smaller value: requires a longer transition zone to avoid flow instability.

bambu.filament_metal_stickiness.label: Metal stickiness
bambu.filament_metal_stickiness.tooltip: Indicates how strongly the filament tends to stick to the metal nozzle and leave residue. "None" means untested or custom filament, behaves the same as Low. Low: e.g. PLA - retraction can be safely skipped in infill areas. Medium: moderate stickiness - use with caution. High: e.g. PETG - retraction should not be skipped to avoid oozing artifacts on outer walls.

bambu.filament_scarf_seam_type.label: Scarf seam type
bambu.filament_scarf_seam_type.tooltip: Set scarf seam type for this filament. This setting could minimize seam visibiliy.

bambu.filament_scarf_height.label: Scarf start height
bambu.filament_scarf_height.tooltip: This amount can be specified in millimeters or as a percentage of the current layer height.

bambu.filament_scarf_gap.label: Scarf slope gap
bambu.filament_scarf_gap.tooltip: In order to reduce the visiblity of the seam in closed loop, the inner wall and outer wall are shortened by a specified amount.

bambu.filament_scarf_length.label: Scarf length
bambu.filament_scarf_length.tooltip: Length of the scarf. Setting this parameter to zero effectively disables the scarf.

bambu.initial_layer_infill_line_width.label: Initial layer infill
bambu.initial_layer_infill_line_width.tooltip: Line width of the infill of initial layer, including sparse infill, solid infill and top surface. Walls, support and everything else of the initial layer are not affected and keep using the line width of initial layer. Zero means to use the line width of initial layer.

bambu.print_in_clockwise.label: Print loops in clockwise
bambu.print_in_clockwise.tooltip: Print in clockwise when enabled, or counterclockwise when not enabled, not work for spiral vase mode

bambu.enable_order_independent_overlap_c.label: Order-independent overlap carving
bambu.enable_order_independent_overlap_c.tooltip: When enabled, overlapping model parts are carved by bounding-box size so smaller embedded parts are not removed by larger parts due to volume order.

bambu.infill_rotate_step.label: Infill rotate step
bambu.infill_rotate_step.tooltip: This parameter adds a slight rotation to each layer of infill to create a cross texture.

bambu.conformal_infill.label: Conformal infill
bambu.conformal_infill.tooltip: Make sparse infill follow each layer's outline instead of using one set of parallel lines. On elongated or curved shapes, lines radiate from a center. Applies to Zig Zag, Cross Zag, Rectilinear, Aligned Rectilinear, and Locked Zag skin.

bambu.conformal_stagger.label: Layer stagger
bambu.conformal_stagger.tooltip: How neighboring layers are offset. Off stacks the same layout. Alternate keeps the same line directions but connects each line to the neighboring one on the opposite side, which improves interlayer bonding.

bambu.conformal_link_keep_layers.label: Conformal forward layers
bambu.conformal_link_keep_layers.tooltip: Number of consecutive layers that keep the forward zigzag. Together with Reverse layers this repeats: N forward, then M reversed. 0 means reverse from the first layer.

bambu.conformal_link_flip_layers.label: Conformal reverse layers
bambu.conformal_link_flip_layers.tooltip: Number of consecutive layers that reverse the zigzag (start from the opposite rim). 0 disables reversing. Forward 1 and Reverse 1 reverses every other layer.

bambu.conformal_pole.label: Radial center
bambu.conformal_pole.tooltip: Where the radial center comes from. Each layer picks a center on that slice. Axis fits one 3D line through those centers. Smooth curve fits a curve so the center does not jump between layers.

bambu.conformal_ray_count.label: Radial line count
bambu.conformal_ray_count.tooltip: How many radial lines around the center. 0 uses the count from sparse infill density. A positive value is the radial line count, rounded up to an even number of at least 4.

bambu.conformal_hub_radius.label: Center region radius
bambu.conformal_hub_radius.tooltip: Radius of the center region that uses ordinary rectilinear infill; outside this circle the infill stays radial. 0 chooses the radius automatically. A positive value is in millimeters.

bambu.sparse_infill_lattice_angle_1.label: Lattice angle 1
bambu.sparse_infill_lattice_angle_1.tooltip: The angle of the first set of 2D lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.

bambu.sparse_infill_lattice_angle_2.label: Lattice angle 2
bambu.sparse_infill_lattice_angle_2.tooltip: The angle of the second set of 2D lattice elements in the Z direction. Zero is vertical.

bambu.silent_mode.label: Supports silent mode
bambu.silent_mode.tooltip: Whether the machine supports silent mode in which machine use lower acceleration to print

bambu.reduce_infill_retraction_mode.label: Reduce infill retraction
bambu.reduce_infill_retraction_mode.tooltip: Controls whether retraction is skipped when traveling within the infill area. "Auto" enables this optimization for filaments with low metal stickiness (e.g. PLA) and disables it for medium/high metal stickiness filaments (e.g. PETG) to avoid oozing artifacts. "Enabled" always skips retraction in infill areas regardless of filament type. "Disabled" always retracts normally.

bambu.smooth_speed_discontinuity_area.label: Smooth speed discontinuity area
bambu.smooth_speed_discontinuity_area.tooltip: Add the speed transition between discontinuity area.

bambu.smooth_coefficient.label: Smooth coefficient
bambu.smooth_coefficient.tooltip: The smaller the number, the longer the speed transition path. 0 means not apply.

bambu.embedding_wall_into_infill.label: Embedding the wall into the infill
bambu.embedding_wall_into_infill.tooltip: Embedding the wall into parts where the wall loops are absent ensures that the wall connects seamlessly to the infill.

bambu.periodic_modifier.label: Periodic modifier
bambu.periodic_modifier.tooltip: Apply this modifier on a repeating layer cycle. On skipped layers it is ignored, as if this modifier were not there.

bambu.periodic_modifier_skip_layers.label: Periodic modifier skip layers
bambu.periodic_modifier_skip_layers.tooltip: Number of consecutive layers on which this modifier is not applied. 0 means the modifier is applied on every layer.

bambu.periodic_modifier_apply_layers.label: Periodic modifier apply layers
bambu.periodic_modifier_apply_layers.tooltip: Number of consecutive layers in each cycle on which this modifier is fully applied. The cycle starts at layer 0: first Apply for, then Skip for.

bambu.modifier_ignore_infill.label: Modifier ignore infill settings
bambu.modifier_ignore_infill.tooltip: Do not apply this modifier's infill settings (pattern, density, conformal infill, and related options). Walls and other overrides still apply. Infill is taken from the parent region.

bambu.extruder_nozzle_stats_new.label: Extruder nozzle stats new
bambu.extruder_nozzle_stats_new.provenance: Ported from BambuStudio@79df7ae:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp:5100 (label generated from the key)

bambu.seam_placement_away_from_overhangs.label: Seam placement away from overhangs(experimental)
bambu.seam_placement_away_from_overhangs.tooltip: Ensure seam placement away from overhangs for alignment and backing modes.

bambu.override_filament_scarf_seam_setti.label: Override filament scarf seam setting
bambu.override_filament_scarf_seam_setti.tooltip: Overrider filament scarf seam setting and could control settings by modifier.

bambu.seam_slope_gap.label: Scarf slope gap
bambu.seam_slope_gap.tooltip: In order to reduce the visiblity of the seam in closed loop, the inner wall and outer wall are shortened by a specified amount.

bambu.role_base_wipe_speed.label: Role-based wipe speed
bambu.role_base_wipe_speed.tooltip: The wipe speed is determined by speed of current extrusion role. e.g if a wipe action is executed immediately following an outer wall extrusion, the speed of the outer wall extrusion will be utilized for the wipe action.

bambu.skirt_per_object.label: Skirt per object
bambu.skirt_per_object.tooltip: Generate independent skirt around each object in sequential printing mode. When disabled, a single skirt is drawn around all objects.

bambu.enable_support_ironing.label: Enable ironing support interface
bambu.enable_support_ironing.tooltip: Ironing is using small flow to print on same height of surface again to make flat surface more smooth. This setting controls whether support interface or raft interface will be ironned.Support ironing could only works on solid interface,that is, support_interface_spacing was zero and support_interface_pattern was't grid

bambu.support_ironing_inset.label: Support ironing inset
bambu.support_ironing_inset.tooltip: The distance to keep the from the edges of ironing line. 0 means not apply.

bambu.support_ironing_direction.label: Support ironing direction
bambu.support_ironing_direction.tooltip: Angle for ironing, which controls the relative angle between the top surface and ironing

bambu.top_z_overrides_xy_distance.label: Z overrides X/Y
bambu.top_z_overrides_xy_distance.tooltip: When top z distance overrides support/object xy distance, give priority to ensuring that supports are generated beneath overhangs, and a gap of the same size as top z distance is leaved with the model. Whereas in the opposite case, the gap between supports and the model follows support/object xy distance all the time. Only recommended to enable when using HybridTree.

bambu.infill_instead_top_bottom_surfaces.label: Use infill instead of top and bottom surfaces
bambu.infill_instead_top_bottom_surfaces.tooltip: Using infill instead of top and bottom surfaces.

bambu.enable_circle_compensation.label: Auto circle contour-hole compensation
bambu.enable_circle_compensation.tooltip: Expirment feature to compensate the circle holes and circle contour. This feature is used to improve the accuracy of the circle holes and contour within the diameter below 50mm. Only support PLA Basic, PLA CF, PET CF, PETG CF and PETG HF.

bambu.circle_compensation_manual_offset.label: User Customized Offset
bambu.circle_compensation_manual_offset.tooltip: If you want to have tighter or looser assemble, you can set this value. When it is positive, it indicates tightening, otherwise, it indicates loosening

bambu.apply_scarf_seam_on_circles.label: Scarf Seam On Compensation Circles
bambu.apply_scarf_seam_on_circles.tooltip: Scarf seam will be applied on circles for better dimensional accuracy.

bambu.prime_tower_max_speed.label: Max speed
bambu.prime_tower_max_speed.tooltip: The maximum printing speed on the prime tower excluding ramming.

bambu.prime_tower_lift_speed.label: Prime tower lift speed
bambu.prime_tower_lift_speed.provenance: Ported from BambuStudio@79df7ae:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp:6434 (label generated from the key)

bambu.prime_tower_lift_height.label: Prime tower lift height
bambu.prime_tower_lift_height.provenance: Ported from BambuStudio@79df7ae:src/libslic3r/PrintConfig.cpp:6437 (label generated from the key)

bambu.prime_tower_rib_wall.label: Rib wall
bambu.prime_tower_rib_wall.tooltip: The wall of prime tower will add four ribs and make its cross-section as close to a square as possible, so the width will be fixed.

bambu.filament_enable_overhang_speed.label: Slow down for overhang
bambu.filament_enable_overhang_speed.tooltip: Enable this option to slow printing down for different overhang degree

bambu.filament_bridge_speed.label: Bridge
bambu.filament_bridge_speed.tooltip: Speed of bridge and completely overhang wall

bambu.filament_overhang_totally_speed.tooltip: Speed of 100% overhang wall which has 0 overlap with the lower layer.

bambu.override_process_overhang_speed.label: Override overhang speed
bambu.override_process_overhang_speed.tooltip: Override the overhang speed in process page
